scope: original single-VEV S+VLL field content; zero-portal and decoupled-VLL benchmark
interpretation: The mA >= ms four-body contribution is a double-spectral diagonal-pairing result; identical-flavor exchange is bounded but not explicitly integrated.
For mA >= ms, the four-body width scales as gX^6 when the off-shell absorptive term is neglected; its effect on direct branching fractions is enclosed by the reported intervals.
The portal is set to zero and VLLs are decoupled by benchmark; these are assumptions, not symmetry-enforced results.
No Belle II detector-level recast or experimental exclusion is produced by this scan.

points_with_bounded_branching_fractions counts all rows with an interval, including degenerate intervals; points_with_nontrivial_branching_fraction_intervals counts only rows with a nonzero exchange-bound interval.
lambdaS_le_4pi_points applies only the scalar-quartic criterion; scalar-Yukawa perturbativity is reported separately using |y_sll|^2 <= 4 pi, and the combined count requires both.
The maximum Gamma_s/m_s is reported over all points, the lambdaS-only subset, and the combined lambdaS-plus-scalar-Yukawa subset; the lambdaS-only subset must not be called fully perturbative.
